products.title: Neovolt Product Catalog
products.subtitle: Bytewatt-certified energy storage systems — single-phase residential and three-phase commercial.

products.threePhaseIntro: For hotels, offices, clinics, and commercial buildings. 400Vac three-phase. Up to 15kW output. Parallel-capable up to 6 units.
products.batteriesIntro: All batteries use EVE Tier 1 prismatic LiFePO4 cells. 10-year warranty. 8,000+ cycle life. Cebu tropical climate rated (−10 to +60°C).

about.title: About OptiCore Energy Solutions
about.subtitle: Cebu-based solar + ESS integrator serving Eastern and Central Visayas.
about.founderBio: OptiCore Energy Solutions was founded to solve a real gap in the Cebu market — the lack of a locally based, licensed engineer offering end-to-end solar and ESS design, installation, and after-sales support. As a Registered Mechanical Engineer specializing in mechanical and electrical systems, Engr. Julius Rey Gisto brings engineering-grade precision to every project, from initial load analysis through to commissioning and warranty registration.
about.cred1: Registered Mechanical Engineer (RME) — Professional Regulation Commission
about.cred2: Technical Background: Mechanical & Electrical Systems, Energy Audit, CAD
about.cred3: Specialty: Solar PV design, ESS sizing, Philippine grid interconnection
about.cred4: Location: Cebu City — serving Cebu, Bohol, and Eastern Visayas
about.partner1Bio: Registered Mechanical Engineer with hands-on hybrid inverter and solar panel installation experience. Leads a certified crew.
about.partner2Role: Independent Regional Partner — Leyte & Eastern Visayas
about.partner2Bio: Engr. Aldrean T. Polistico, ECE/ECT. Licensed Electronics Engineer and Technician with TESDA NCII Solar PV certification. Established solar installation business with completed residential and commercial projects across Region VIII.
about.mission: OptiCore's mission is to make reliable, professionally engineered solar and battery storage accessible to Filipino homes and businesses — with transparent pricing, honest engineering, and local support you can actually reach.
about.territoryCebu: Cebu — Metro Cebu and provincial areas
about.territoryLeyte: Leyte — LEYECO/DOMELCO, via certified regional partner

informationCollection.heading: Information We Collect
informationCollection.p1: We collect personal information you provide when filling out forms on our website, including your name, email address, phone number, property address, and monthly electric bill amount.
informationCollection.p2: We automatically collect certain technical information when you visit our site, including your IP address, browser type, operating system, referring URLs, and pages visited.
informationCollection.p3: We may collect information about your property and energy usage through our free site assessment process, including roof dimensions, electrical panel specifications, and existing utility connections.
informationCollection.p4: Payment and billing information is collected when you engage our services, processed securely through our third-party payment processor.

howWeUse.heading: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.p1: To provide solar and ESS design, sizing, and installation services you request.
howWeUse.p2: To communicate with you about your assessment, system design, installation schedule, and after-sales support.
howWeUse.p3: To improve our website, services, and customer experience through analytics and feedback.
howWeUse.p4: To comply with legal obligations, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
howWeUse.p5: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Your data is used exclusively for OptiCore Energy Solutions business operations.

sharing.heading: Information Sharing
sharing.p1: We share information with our installation partners and suppliers as necessary to deliver our services, including Bytewatt Inc. for product warranties.
sharing.p2: We may share information with regulatory bodies (ERC, DOE) as required for compliance with Philippine energy regulations.
sharing.p3: We use third-party service providers for email delivery, payment processing, and analytics who are bound by data processing agreements.

dataSecurity.heading: Data Security
dataSecurity.p1: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption, access controls, and regular security audits to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

yourRights.heading: Your Rights
yourRights.p1: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you.
yourRights.p2: You have the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
yourRights.p3: You have the right to request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention requirements.
yourRights.p4: You have the right to withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time.
yourRights.p5: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at engineering@opticore.ph.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.p1: We use essential cookies for authentication and site functionality. We also use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our website.
cookies.p2: You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect certain features of our website.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.p1: For questions about this privacy policy or your personal data, contact Julius Rey Gisto at engineering@opticore.ph or call +63 950 469 2442.

services.heading: Services
services.p1: OptiCore Energy Solutions provides solar PV and energy storage system (ESS) design, sizing, procurement, installation, and after-sales support services for residential and commercial clients in Cebu, Bohol, and Leyte.
services.p2: All engineering designs are prepared and stamped by a Registered Mechanical Engineer (RME) in compliance with Philippine regulations.
services.p3: Services are subject to site assessment, structural analysis, and utility coordination requirements.

assessments.heading: Site Assessments
assessments.p1: Free site assessments are offered to qualifying properties within our service areas. Assessment availability depends on location, scheduling, and site accessibility.
assessments.p2: Assessment results are estimates based on visual inspection and bill analysis. Final system design may vary after detailed engineering review.
assessments.p3: We reserve the right to decline service if the site is deemed unsuitable for solar PV or ESS installation.

calculator.heading: ROI Calculator Disclaimer
calculator.p1: The solar ROI calculator provides estimates only and does not constitute a formal proposal or quote.
calculator.p2: Calculations are based on user-provided inputs and publicly available utility rate data. Actual savings depend on system design, installation quality, weather conditions, and future rate changes.
calculator.p3: Payback period estimates assume 5% annual electricity rate escalation. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
calculator.p4: A formal engineering proposal with guaranteed pricing will be provided after site assessment and system design.

warranties.heading: Product Warranties
warranties.p1: Product warranties are provided by the respective manufacturers (Bytewatt Inc., Neovolt) and passed through to the client. Warranty terms vary by product.
warranties.p2: Installation workmanship is warranted by OptiCore Energy Solutions for a period of one year from the date of commissioning.
warranties.p3: Warranty claims must be reported within the warranty period and are subject to manufacturer inspection and approval.

intellectualProperty.heading: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.p1: All system designs, single-line diagrams, load calculations, and engineering plans prepared by OptiCore remain our intellectual property until full payment is received.
intellectualProperty.p2: Upon full payment, the client receives a license to use the engineering documents for the specific installation project.

liability.heading: Limitation of Liability
liability.p1: OptiCore Energy Solutions' liability is limited to the value of services rendered. We are not liable for consequential damages including but not limited to lost savings, business interruption, or property damage.
liability.p2: We do not guarantee that the system will meet specific energy production targets, as actual performance depends on factors beyond our control including weather, roof orientation, and utility grid conditions.
liability.p3: Clients are responsible for obtaining necessary permits and approvals from their local government unit and electric utility.

governingLaw.heading: Governing Law
governingLaw.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Cebu City.

changes.heading: Changes to Terms
changes.p1: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
